properties.project_name: UCSF Neurosurgery at San Francisco Mission Bay
properties.digitized_from: Owner-directed construction, not a hand trace: real-gap-fragment 2 (11,626 sqm raw, from the numbered real-gap-fragment map for this area), idealized to a proper rectangle sharing Third Street Garage's own minimum-rotated-rectangle west edge and orientation, with the north walkway strip (a real gap fragment pinch point, width dropping to ~2m) cut off.
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-20: the owner corrected the prior resolution (block_inventory 23A had pointed at Genentech Hall). The owner directly identified the real building here as UCSF Neurosurgery at San Francisco Mission Bay, west of and adjacent to Third Street Garage. Construction: took real-gap-fragment 2, cut off its north walkway strip at the point the fragment's cross-sectional width pinches to ~2m (lat 37.76878), excluded the portion overlapping/east of Third Street Garage's own real footprint, then idealized the remainder into a proper rectangle aligned with Third Street Garage's own minimum-rotated-rectangle orientation (sharing its exact west edge as the shared border) per the owner's direct instruction. Result: 8,027 sqm.
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- an idealized rectangle (owner-directed construction: real-gap-fragment shape cut and aligned to Third Street Garage's own real orientation), not a hand-traced or surveyed footprint. The building's identity (UCSF Neurosurgery at San Francisco Mission Bay) and adjacency to Third Street Garage are from the owner's direct knowledge; not independently corroborated by a primary source in this pass.
properties.notes: OCII plan block 23A. Previously mismapped to Genentech Hall (a different, separate building further west); Genentech Hall's own real plan-block correlation is now an open question pending future review.
